answer: Rule: each identity locks 100 POA into a ten-member surety ring. One proven fake burns the ring pool of 1,000 POA, so a vertex of ten fakes loses 1,000 at the first audit hit while an honest ring keeps its marble untouched. Cost scales linearly with a tenfold penalty: N fakes risk N x 1,000 POA, and one pearl of evidence, a single fraud finding, wipes the attacker deposit.
